verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents an official CLI that calls the Channel3 API from a terminal or script. It supports image search from URLs or local files and offers selectable output formats with JMESPath field extraction, which suits scripted and agent-driven workflows. The probe confirms official CLI docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and documented install/auth details and command coverage beyond search.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Channel3 CLI calls the Channel3 API from a terminal or script.
Select formats or extract fields with JMESPath.
Search from a public image URL or local image file.
